purpose: Replace only the malformed MuSR task artifacts while preserving the original frozen samples and all unaffected task artifacts.

sample_contract.selection: The same first 100 frozen document IDs, indices 0--99.
sample_contract.identity_check: For all 100 rows, the old logged narrative/question prefix and target match the pinned raw dataset row.

corrected_prompt_contract.choice_parser: Safely decode the string-valued choices field as a literal list or tuple.
corrected_prompt_contract.target_check: answer_index must be 0 or 1 and map to the corresponding label.
corrected_prompt_contract.malformed_input_policy: Raise; never emit a partial artifact.

extraction.generation_protocol: Use the unchanged parent manifest and task generation arguments.

required_gates: sample ID equality with the parent freeze
two choices in every logged prompt
target within A/B for every sample
representation count, finiteness, exact hook semantics, and source checks
tracker-off/on deterministic output parity on a prespecified smoke subset
full cross-panel unadjusted and nuisance-adjusted reanalysis with no failed rows
assembly_rule: Build a new hash manifest over nine unchanged parent task artifacts and one corrected MuSR artifact per model. Never overwrite the parent archive.
claim_gate: No cross-benchmark transfer, localization, profile-correlation, or nuisance-control value may be reported until all required gates pass for all five models.
